title: Open problem: Absence of bi-infinite geodesics in planar iid FPP
statement: OPEN PROBLEM from the Codex campaign ledger (source_says_open; current status unverified; result status attempted_unsolved). For nondegenerate continuous iid planar passage-time laws in the usual positive-speed regime, determine whether a bi-infinite geodesic exists. Source: Auffinger, Damron and Hanson: 50 years of first-passage percolation, Question31, PDF p.98.
